svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Three licence findings, three design changes
svg.desc: Three rows, each pairing a clause of the KX Community Edition License Agreement with the design decision it forced. Row one: Clause 2.1 and Attachment A limit permitted use to personal or internal business use; so the repo makes no commercial-friendliness claims about KDB-X CE, ever, and ships lessons and its own snippets, never KX's software. Row two: Clause 9 forbids disclosing any benchmark, test or performance information, or competitive analysis, without prior written consent; so the planned speed article became a co-design article with no numbers, and the as-of join showcase asserts correctness only. Row three: Clause 4 reserves periodic communication with a KX licence server; so offline or air-gapped verification is treated as at risk, and CI runs only on runners with network egress. The footer says: read the actual agreement before designing anything; your spec's summary of a licence is a claim like any other.
svg.text: Three clauses. Three changes to the design.
WHAT IT DID TO THE BUILD
Ship lessons and own snippets, never KX's software.
The speed article became a design article.
No numbers. The showcase asserts correctness only.
Air-gapped verification treated as at risk.
CI runs only on runners with network egress.
KX Community Edition License Agreement v1.1, 27 Aug 2025. Paraphrased; read the clause numbers, not this figure. Not legal advice.
